title: Dooku’s Moment of Triumph
front_description: Captured by Jango Fett and the Geonosians, Anakin and Padmé are taken to the great execution arena of Geonosis, which is packed with tier upon tier of yelling spectators. Count Dooku and his guests Poggle the Lesser, Nute Gunray and Jango Fett arrive in the archducal box, where they will witness Anakin, Padmé and Obi-Wan's execution. As the two young heroes are led into the arena, Padmé confesses her love for Anakin, and they share a seemingly final kiss.
back_description: Original concept art by Edwin Natividad of the spectacular Geonosian arena.
